note: Distinct from the existing 'The Opening Qasida — Yā Rabbi Ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad' entry — the opening couplet is similar but the supplication that follows is different.

verses.ar:
يَا رَبِّي صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ
يَا رَبِّي صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمْ (2)
verses.tr:
Yā Rabbī ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad
Yā Rabbī ṣalli ʿalayhi wa sallim (2)
verses.en: O my Lord, bless Muhammad; O my Lord, bless him and grant him peace.

verses.ar:
يَا رَبِّي بَلِّغْهُ الْوَسِيلَةْ
يَا رَبِّي خُصَّهُ بِالْفَضِيلَةْ
يَا رَبِّي وَارْضَ عَنِ الصَّحَابَةْ
يَا رَبِّي وَارْضَ عَنِ السُّلَالَةْ
verses.tr:
Yā Rabbī balligh-hu-l-wasīlah
Yā Rabbī khuṣṣahu bi-l-faḍīlah
Yā Rabbī wa-rḍa ʿani-ṣ-ṣaḥābah
Yā Rabbī wa-rḍa ʿani-s-sulālah
verses.en: O my Lord, grant him the highest station in Paradise; O my Lord, single him out with excellence; O my Lord, be pleased with his companions; O my Lord, be pleased with his descendants.

verses.ar:
يَا رَبِّي وَارْضَ عَنِ الْمَشَايِخْ
يَا رَبِّي فَارْحَمْ وَالِدَيْنَا
يَا رَبِّي وَارْحَمْنَا جَمِيعًا
يَا رَبِّي وَارْحَمْ كُلَّ مُسْلِمْ
verses.tr:
Yā Rabbī wa-rḍa ʿani-l-mashāyikh
Yā Rabbī fa-rḥam wālidaynā
Yā Rabbī wa-rḥamnā jamīʿan
Yā Rabbī wa-rḥam kulla Muslim
verses.en: O my Lord, be pleased with the masters; O my Lord, have mercy on our parents; O my Lord, have mercy on all of us; O my Lord, have mercy on every Muslim.

verses.ar:
يَا رَبِّي وَاغْفِرْ لِكُلِّ مُذْنِبْ
يَا رَبِّي يَا سَامِعَ دُعَانَا
يَا رَبِّي لَا تَقْطَعْ رَجَانَا
يَا رَبِّي بَلِّغْنَا نَزُورُهْ
verses.tr:
Yā Rabbī wa-ghfir li-kulli mudhnib
Yā Rabbī yā sāmiʿa duʿānā
Yā Rabbī lā taqṭaʿ rajānā
Yā Rabbī ballighnā nazūruh
verses.en: O my Lord, forgive every sinner; O my Lord, O Hearer of our supplication; O my Lord, do not cut off our hope; O my Lord, grant us to visit him.

verses.ar:
يَا رَبِّي تَغْشَانَا بِنُورِهْ
يَا رَبِّي حِفْظَانَكْ وَأَمَانَكْ
يَا رَبِّي وَأَسْكِنَّا جِنَانَكْ
يَا رَبِّي أَجِرْنَا مِنْ عَذَابِكْ
verses.tr:
Yā Rabbī taghshānā bi-nūrih
Yā Rabbī ḥifẓānak wa amānak
Yā Rabbī wa askinnā jinānak
Yā Rabbī ajirnā min ʿadhābik
verses.en: O my Lord, cover us with his light; O my Lord, grant us Your protection and safety; O my Lord, house us in Your gardens; O my Lord, shelter us from Your punishment.

verses.ar:
يَا رَبِّي وَارْزُقْنَا الشَّهَادَةْ
يَا رَبِّي حُطْنَا بِالسَّعَادَةْ
يَا رَبِّي وَأَصْلِحْ كُلَّ مُصْلِحْ
يَا رَبِّي وَاكْفِ كُلَّ مُؤْذٍ
verses.tr:
Yā Rabbī wa-rzuqna-sh-shahādah
Yā Rabbī ḥuṭṭnā bi-s-saʿādah
Yā Rabbī wa aṣliḥ kulla muṣliḥ
Yā Rabbī wa-kfi kulla muʾdhin
verses.en: O my Lord, grant us the rank of the martyrs; O my Lord, surround us with happiness; O my Lord, set right every one who seeks to reform; O my Lord, spare us the harm of every one who causes harm.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālih
verses.en: O Allah, send peace and blessings upon him and his family.
